gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ this metro line run this late.
gaps.explanation: Rarely at the front: does + subject + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: Nowhere ___ you find a better example of Gothic architecture.
No sooner had he sat down ___ the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: No sooner … than — fixed pair with inversion after 'no sooner'.

gaps.sentence: Seldom does a debut novel ___ so much critical attention.
gaps.explanation: 'Seldom does a novel receive …' — the auxiliary 'does' carries tense; base verb follows.

gaps.sentence: Not until every passenger had been evacuated ___ the captain leave the ship.
gaps.explanation: 'Not until … did the captain leave …' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Never have I ___ such a stubborn refusal.
gaps.explanation: Inversion: Never have I + past participle — never adds emphasis.

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we started ___ the engine failed.
gaps.explanation: Hardly … when — fixed pair: Hardly had we started when…

gaps.sentence: Only after the third attempt ___ she pass the test.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' at the front forces question word order: did she pass.
